author: Zephyr I
title: Ablation: remove time input (late-injection arch) — std-width nodil (BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Quantify the contribution of time by removing the time channel entirely in the late-injection SOTA architecture. Std-width CNN (32/64) with d=5 on main convs only, undilated bottleneck 3×3s, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), single-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip. BASE_SEED=42.
